author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, Bombardier gives an overview of the techniques used in the creation of their configurator for private jets. 

This tool is designed to facilitate clients in efficiently and thoroughly choosing their options and materials during meetings with Bombardier’s customer-facing team. The configurator is completely data-driven and makes extensive use of data structures. Everything in it is dynamic—from the menus to the levels—and updated in real time based on selections made by the user. 

The team can quickly add, remove, or modify existing data, without affecting the configurator itself. All the elements are imported separately and the tool takes care of assembling everything. This enables the generation of thousands of permutations in real time, along with a dependency and placeholder system to avoid updating hundreds of levels.

title: Creating a Dynamic and Modular Configurator for Private Jets | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
As game worlds grow larger and more ambitious, making them feel truly alive becomes an increasingly complex challenge. Populating vast environments with creatures that react to the player, respond to the world, and remain performant at scale often requires more than traditional animation or AI-driven approaches. 

In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, we explore how Unreal Engine’s Niagara system can be used to drive player-aware, interactive living world creatures in a lightweight and scalable way. 

These systems were originally developed and production-tested in Fortnite and are designed to scale to massive, dynamic worlds. You’ll see how Niagara can go beyond visual effects to power motion, behavior, and world interaction, while remaining efficient enough for large-scale environments.

title: Building Living World Creatures with Niagara | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
